name: 93304 · Bakersfield, CA
findings: ZIP 93304 (Bakersfield) has 97 nonprofit organizations. 29 of them (30%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 21 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (34% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 93304 (Bakersfield) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 93304 (Bakersfield) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 56% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 37 organizations here; 20% of all organizations here have no identified type.
